text:
cheng: Quick check-in — ran a stripe-batcher sweep across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100. Notes below. A10/L4 hit kernel spill earlier than expected; H100 scales but KV-frag spikes around ~12k tokens. Anyone else seeing similar?
maya: Haha, great name. Can you paste the config you used?
cheng: sure, here's the exact config I ran on the sweep:
```json
{
  "batcher": "stripe",
  "max_tokens_per_batch": {"A10": 8000, "T4": 6000, "L4": 5000, "A100": 12000, "H100": 16000},
  "kernel_selector": "auto",
  "kv_cache_policy": "kv-aware"
}
```
oliver: nice. did you run kernel_selector=v2 for A100/H100? kernel fallbacks matter a lot for A10.
cheng: yep — v2 on A100/H100, v1 on L4/T4/A10. quick throughput notes: H100 ~1.8x baseline at 12k tokens, A100 steady until ~10k then drops, T4 latency climbs nonlinearly after ~4k.
profiling-bot: Profile summary: H100_peak=2.1G tokens/s; A100_peak=1.3G; A10=0.6G; L4=0.55G; T4=0.35G. KV cache miss penalty median +12ms (A10/L4), +4ms (H100).
maya: Can you drop the perf/regression graphs? especially KV miss tail.
cheng: uploaded graphs to the internal dashboard — main takeaway: enabling kv-aware packing for A10 reduces miss tail ~30%. Link: https://internal/perf/stripes/1768456789
sal: quick question — how deterministic is stripe-batcher with high seq-length variance? we saw packing fairness issues in prior runs.
cheng: it's somewhat stochastic — we seed the packer, but when request entropy is high stripe sometimes underfills batches. propose adding a soft cap + dynamic fallback to greedy packing when fill ratio < threshold.
oliver: suggestion for soft-cap: compute per-card max_tokens = floor(base * adjust_by_kv_frag). pseudocode:
```python
def select_max_tokens(card, hist):
    base = gpu_lookup[card]
    frag = hist.kv_frag_ratio(card)
    return int(base * max(0.6, 1 - frag*0.4))
```
maya: :thumbsup: let's canary that. cheng, can you spin a canary on dev-rack-3?
cheng: on it — launching canary now.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for stripe-batcher softcap-v1 -> rack dev-rack-3 (build 4532)
profiling-bot: Canary results after 30m: latency p95 improved 9% on A10, throughput +6% overall, KV-miss rate down 22%.
sal: any regressions on H100/A100?
cheng: no regressions observed; H100 improved slightly. note: A100 memory fragmentation increases when stripe_width > 8 — we should run mem-defrag between rollouts.
maya: Action items: 1) add softcap heuristic to stripe-batcher (cheng) 2) mem-defrag step for A100 canaries (sal) 3) expand KV-aware packing baseline for A10/L4 (maya/oliver). i'll open the tickets + PR templates.
sal: i'll own the mem-defrag task.
oliver: i'll review the PRs when posted.
cheng: i'll draft the short runbook + paste final numbers in eng-runtime weekly thread. thanks all!
